summary: The four docs-reading invariants read through `lib/docs/source.ts`, so CI's `alignsynch` lane builds `docs.tar.zst` and runs the same gate with `DOCS_SOURCE=bundle` while `quizhub` stays `local`.
reader_impact: Nobody sees a different screen: both lanes draw `/admin/docs*`, `/glossary` and the spec register identically, and the run prints `docs source: local|bundle` beside its lane.
